tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark: Options A and B. Paper: Option C. Body text `ink` reads on it in both.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels and tile chrome (header/footer bars, scoreboard, map panel).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised rows: hovered scoreboard row, drawer handle, selected timeline window.

tokens.name: feed
tokens.usage: Flat muted 4:3 feed placeholder fill. Never a screenshot or game art.

tokens.name: feed-grid
tokens.usage: Technical grid lines inside a feed placeholder.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet hairlines between data cells; HP bar track.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Tile borders and section rules. Paper: stark ink rule.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Panel frames, dead-tile dashed border, pinned map frame.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, numerals, clock. 15:1+ on surface-0/1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels (column heads, weapon, state). 7:1 on surface-0, 6:1 on surface-1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-essential marks only: feed meta, grid labels, minute ticks (3:1+, never body text).

tokens.name: on-bot
tokens.usage: Text and swatch on a filled bot-colour header (In Combat tiles, behaviour chip).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring on every surface (3:1+).

tokens.name: bot-01
tokens.usage: 01 VEX · Vex · Rusher. Vermilion.

tokens.name: bot-02
tokens.usage: 02 KRN · Kronos · Tactician. Signal blue.

tokens.name: bot-03
tokens.usage: 03 NUL · Null · Ambusher. Violet.

tokens.name: bot-04
tokens.usage: 04 ASH · Ash · Berserker. Sulphur (paper: mustard).

tokens.name: bot-05
tokens.usage: 05 ORB · Orbit · Kiter. Green.

tokens.name: bot-06
tokens.usage: 06 HEX · Hex · Camper. Ice cyan (lighter than KRN to separate by lightness).

tokens.name: bot-07
tokens.usage: 07 PYR · Pyre · Flanker. Amber orange (lighter than VEX).

tokens.name: bot-08
tokens.usage: 08 ZED · Zed · Erratic. Magenta.

styles.name: bc-title
styles.usage: App wordmark set in type (no logo) in A and B headers.

styles.name: bc-name
styles.usage: Bot name on tile nameplates, uppercase.

styles.name: bc-stage
styles.usage: Focused bot name in the telemetry panel.

styles.name: data-num
styles.usage: Frags and deaths in tiles and scoreboard.

styles.name: ed-numeral
styles.usage: Option C tile and leaderboard numerals.

styles.name: ed-kicker
styles.usage: Option C section heads over a heavy ink rule.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside dense data cells.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Multiview gutter between feeds (Option A).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile header padding; outer frame inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Option B/C gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Option C structured whitespace between columns.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: tiles, panels, buttons. Square broadcast chrome.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Keycap hints only ([ESC], [M]).

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Map dots.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Default tile border and table rules.

tokens.name: stroke-hot
tokens.usage: In Combat tile border (bot colour).

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Option C ink section rules.
